title: Bridal Makeup Tips for Your Big Day
excerpt: Essential tips to look flawless on your wedding day.
content: Book a trial at least 2 weeks before your wedding. Choose long-lasting products and hydrate your skin well before the appointment. At Huma Beauty Saloon we customize every bridal look to match your outfit and venue lighting.

title: Summer Skincare at the Salon
excerpt: Keep your skin glowing during hot Jhelum summers.
content: Hydra facial and regular cleansing help fight summer dryness and sun damage. Visit us monthly for best results. Drink water and use SPF daily between salon visits.
